summary: Remove the two OAuth callback endpoints from the command surface.
reason: /integration/callback and /task_mcp_server/callback are provider redirect targets; a person supplying their own code/state can never succeed, so both returned exit 5 on every live probe. Removed via the novel-command hook rather than by editing generated files, so regeneration cannot resurrect them.
validated_outcome: Full live dogfood matrix: four failures on these two commands eliminated; project integration and project task-mcp-server unaffected.
